# anthropic_plugin_marketplaces (Data Source)

Beta. Lists Claude Enterprise plugin marketplaces, the organization's own and its members' personal ones (`GET /v1/organizations/plugin_marketplaces`). Available to Claude Enterprise organizations only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_plugin_marketplaces" "org" {
  owner_type = "organization"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `owner_type` (String) Only marketplaces with this owner: `organization` or `user`.
- `source` (String) Only marketplaces with this source: `manual`, `github`, `gitlab` or `public_git`.

### Read-Only

- `marketplaces` (Attributes List) Plugin marketplaces, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--marketplaces))

<a id="nestedatt--marketplaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `marketplaces`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the marketplace was created.
- `default_installation_preference` (String) Organization-wide installation setting for plugins without their own: `required`, `auto_install`, `available` or `not_available`. Null for a personal marketplace.
- `id` (String) ID of the plugin marketplace (`marketplace_...`).
- `last_sync_ended_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the most recent synchronization attempt ended. Null when not synchronized.
- `last_sync_read_sha` (String) Commit the last synchronization read. Null when not synchronized.
- `name` (String) Name of the marketplace, fixed for its lifetime.
- `owner_type` (String) `organization`, or `user` for a member's personal marketplace.
- `owner_user_id` (String) User ID of the member who owns a personal marketplace. Null for an organization marketplace.
- `source` (String) Where its plugins come from: `manual` (uploaded), or `github`, `gitlab`, `public_git` (synchronized from a Git repository).
- `sync_status` (String) Outcome of the most recent repository synchronization. Null when never synchronized.
